_comment: Target profiles. Each value: v (number or null), s = status. 'measured' = computed by our pipeline from NASA data at the Earth index's scale (pipeline/measure_targets.py; 'was' keeps the old placeholder); 'verify' = published or mission-measured value, still to be re-extracted at matched scale; 'estimate' = order-of-magnitude placeholder pending pipeline extraction (LOLA, Diviner, MOLA, THEMIS, MEDA/REMS); null = not known, which scores as Unknown. Regional terrain values are at ~15-55 km scale to match the Earth 0.5° index.
